responsibility: This header connects the MIPS backend to the GCC D front end by declaring the MIPS-specific D hook functions and mapping them onto TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO. Its role is not to implement policy itself, but to publish and install the hook entry points defined in mips-d.cc.
same_name_distinction: Unlike mips-d.cc, this header does not derive any D target information itself; it only declares the MIPS D hook entry points and installs them via TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO macros for use by the rest of the port.
